answer: Resist sybils with a counterparty-diversity cap: influence counts only from distinct, independent counterparties, each allowed to meaningfully endorse just a few identities per epoch. A farmer's thousand clones all whisper to the same handful of wallets, so their endorsements collapse into one anchor of trust, not a thousand. One honest agent with many real clients — a lone raven, not a flock sharing one purse — outranks them all, because endorsements from wallets sharing a funding trail are discounted to a single voice.
